description: This file defines the SecurePrefs class responsible for managing secure and non-secure application preferences, including encryption, storing, and retrieving configuration data such as wake words, notification settings, gateway tokens, and user preferences within an Android application.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A class for managing application preferences with secure storage for sensitive data, including configuration, user preferences, and notification settings, using Android SharedPreferences with encryption support.

methods.name: createSecurePrefs
methods.description: Creates an encrypted SharedPreferences instance using AndroidX Security library.

methods.name: loadOrCreateInstanceId
methods.description: Loads or generates a new unique instance ID.

methods.name: loadOrMigrateDisplayName
methods.description: Loads or migrates the device display name, providing a default if none exists.

methods.name: loadNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Parses and loads the set of notification forwarding packages from preferences.

methods.name: loadVoiceWakeMode
methods.description: Loads the voice wake mode preference, setting a default if unset.

methods.name: loadLocationMode
methods.description: Loads the LocationMode setting, with migration logic for deprecated values.

methods.name: loadWakeWords
methods.description: Retrieves and sanitizes the wake words list from preferences.
